$comment: What this SDK actually does. `supported` means the contract suite exercises it; `not_supported` is a real gap stated in the SDK's own voice; `planned` is accepted work not yet landed. scripts/gen-sdk-matrix.mjs renders clients/README.md's capability table from these three files and CI diff-checks the result, so a README can no longer promise a feature one language does not have.

notes.admit: Pre-spend admission: `enforce: "block" | "warn" | "off"` (default off) on the client, gated inside wrapOpenAI/wrapAnthropic/wrapGemini; `lt.admit()` for the raw verdict. The client does not choose the event id (the server mints it), so local shedding matches the server's RATE but not its exact set; hard caps and the advertised 429 wait are exact.
notes.batch: No client-side batching: sends are individual un-awaited POSTs. /v1/events/batch exists server-side.
